Alice — thanks for the checklist and timeline. Please find our initial evidence package below and a short summary addressing each of your items. Links/attachments follow.

Executive summary (short):
- Default behavior: Customer-provided prompts and model outputs on the hosted Redwood API are NOT used to continue-training or update model weights by default. Training on customer data is only performed if the customer signs an explicit opt-in amendment that authorizes aggregation and model fine-tuning.
- Opt-out / no-train: We support a per-account "no_train" flag and an API-level header (X-Redwood-No-Train: true) that prevent any prompt/response data from being routed into long-term training or fine-tuning pipelines. The flag is immediately effective.
- Retention windows: prompts/responses (ephemeral): default 30 days for hosted troubleshooting; diagnostic logs (structured telemetry): 365 days; backups/snapshots: 400 days for recovery purposes. Long-term aggregated telemetry (non-identifiable) retained indefinitely for product quality metrics.
- Deletion / export: Customers can request a full export of interaction history via the console or Support ticket (CSV export). Deletion requests (per-account) are handled by our Data Operations process with a 14-day fulfillment SLA; deletion is cascaded to backups as part of our data hygiene sweep (see evidence).
- PII handling: We apply token-level redaction on configured sensitive fields and offer a pseudonymization pipeline to customers who need stronger controls. Logs are encrypted at rest and access is role-based.
- HIPAA / Financial controls: For regulated workloads we offer Dedicated and Private deployments plus a BAA. We can also provide SCIM + KMS integrations for key separation.

Attached / linked evidence:
- Redwood_DPIA_Summary.pdf (one-page summary addressing training and opt-out) — attached
- Redwood_SCCs_Annex_signed.pdf — signed SCC annex (link below)
- SOC2_Report_Redwood_2026.pdf — redacted SOC 2 report (link)
- retention_matrix.csv — explicit retention windows and data flow notes (attached)
- Playbook: "How to enable no-train" — admin console screenshot and API sample (link)

Useful links / artifacts:
- Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-privacy-pack
- HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/CB-202704

Notes on operational guarantees:
- Opt-out enforcement: Setting the "no_train" flag triggers config that prevents routing to model training pipelines; we also log the config change and create an immutable audit entry.
- Proof of deletion: After a deletion request is completed we generate a deletion certificate (signed by DataOps) that we can share with customers.
- Exceptions: For Dedicated/Private deployments, retention and deletion behavior is configurable per contract; the hosted defaults above apply to our standard hosted offering.

Next steps:
- If you confirm ClearBank's pilot will use our hosted API, the attached pack is the correct evidence set. If you're evaluating Dedicated/Private, tell us and we'll pull the contract-specific artifacts.
- Happy to set a 30-minute walkthrough next week to go through the evidence and show the admin flow; propose 2027-04-19 or 2027-04-20.

Regards,
